metadata.title: Heroes - Crisis Response & Missing Persons Locator
metadata.description: A resilient and optimized platform designed for crisis situations to facilitate the locating of unaccounted individuals, maximizing local persistence, battery efficiency, and secure coordination between families and rescuers.

community.title: Open Source Community
community.subtitle: Free and non-profit project. Join us by submitting a Pull Request!

about.title: Heroes Project
about.description: A community-driven platform to quickly and freely locate health centers, missing persons, and critical resources in times of need.

license.title: MIT License
license.description: This software is 100% free. You have full freedom to use, modify, and distribute it. The only legal requirement is to maintain copyright and original attribution.

contribute.title: How to Contribute?
contribute.description: Found a bug or have a UX/UI enhancement? Check our architecture guides, clone the repository, and start contributing via a Pull Request to `main`.

protocol.title: Crisis Action Protocols
protocol.subtitle: Clear instructions and fundamental steps to act in a coordinated manner during an emergency.

firstHours.title: First 24 hours
firstHours.content: Don't wait 24 to 48 hours to act. Contact local authorities immediately. Gather a recent photo, last-seen clothing, distinguishing marks, and close-family contacts.

usingApp.title: Publish a report
usingApp.content: Create a report in Heroes with the person's photo, pin the last known location, and check the minor option so sensitive details stay protected.

clarity.title: Clarity and objective data
clarity.description: Share exact location, affected count, and the specific help required.

verification.title: Verify before sharing
verification.description: Confirm accuracy before sharing; misinformation diverts critical resources.

privacy.title: Protect sensitive information
privacy.description: Don't expose third-party identities or documents without consent.
